claim.text: HumPool and F2Pool jointly produce 53.9% of Kaspa blocks

sources.rest_indexer: https://api.kaspa.org (used only to locate the paging start block, for explorer address labels, and for sample cross-checks)

window_completeness.note: Blocks never merged by the selected chain (outside the past of the sink at query time) are not returned by getBlocks; the secondary-node enumeration is the cross-check.

colors.rule: BLUE/RED only when GetBlockRewardInfo returns it; anything else kept as UNKNOWN

attribution.rule: miner = the block's own coinbase payload (script public key + extra data). Pool from payload tag; else address seen with a pool tag in >=90% of its window blocks; else explorer label; else SOLO if the untagged, unlabelled address produced <1% of window blocks (heuristic); else UNKNOWN (also when no standard miner address can be derived). Coinbase payout recipients are never used.

sample_verification.selection: sha256(seed + hash) ascending over all window blocks, first N
